title: git-tools module diagram
description: The library's modules and how they depend on each other, from the `use crate::` lines. The three binaries in bin/ each call one entry point: router::main, commit::main or message::main.

components.name: git-tools sources
components.responsibility: The library and the three binaries.

components.name: Entry points (bin/)
components.responsibility: git-tools, git-tools-commit and git-tools-commit-message-editor: each exits with one module's main.

components.name: Router (router.rs)
components.responsibility: Answers help and version, runs message and commit, and hands everything else to git.

components.name: Commit flow (commit.rs)
components.responsibility: Splits its options from git commit's, keeps the draft and saved marks in the git directory, opens the editor with the changed files, carries out the marks and runs git commit.

components.name: Editor offer (offer.rs)
components.responsibility: On the first zazzle git commit, asks once on the terminal whether to set core.editor to zazzle git message, records that it asked in the global git config, and holds the how-to text the help shows.

components.name: File marks (files.rs)
components.responsibility: Parses git status into entries with starting marks, cycles and saves marks, and turns them into git steps.

components.name: Message command (message.rs)
components.responsibility: Loads the file (256 KiB, UTF-8), splits off git's comment tail, runs the editor on the terminal and saves atomically.

components.name: Editor (editor.rs)
components.responsibility: The editor state and what each key does in the editing, Files and Rebase views, the find bar and the prompts.

components.name: Buffer (buffer.rs)
components.responsibility: Editable lines, the read-only tail, cursor, selection, movement and undo history.

components.name: Find (find.rs)
components.responsibility: Plain-text search and replace-all, ignoring case unless the query has a capital.

components.name: Rebase todo (rebase.rs)
components.responsibility: Reads and sets each todo line's command and warns about a squash or fixup with no commit before it.

components.name: File kinds (kind.rs)
components.responsibility: Recognises commit messages, rebase todo lists, pull request bodies and changelogs by name, with their line limits and labels, and splits off git's comment tail.

components.name: Arrow taps (tap.rs)
components.responsibility: Counts double and triple arrow taps and tells them from a held key.

components.name: Clipboard (clipboard.rs)
components.responsibility: Copy and paste through pbcopy, wl-copy or xclip, with an in-memory fallback.

components.name: Key decoding (keys.rs)
components.responsibility: Turns terminal bytes into key events: legacy sequences, the kitty keyboard protocol and bracketed paste.

components.name: Rendering (render.rs)
components.responsibility: Draws one frame: text or list, find bar, status line, key bar and help.

components.name: Terminal (term.rs)
components.responsibility: Raw mode on /dev/tty with restore on exit, panic or signal, the window size and the loop that feeds keys to the editor.

components.name: Process runner (git.rs)
components.responsibility: Runs git and other commands captured with a timeout, attached to the terminal, or by replacing the process.

components.name: git
components.responsibility: The git on PATH.

components.name: Clipboard commands
components.responsibility: pbcopy and pbpaste, wl-copy and wl-paste, or xclip.
